I posted the bullets in #coastal-team, replying to you.

I also made a mistake: I saved the note to June as a draft, but it went into my mailbox, not yours, so you won't find it in your drafts. I posted a correction in the thread. The draft is addressed to June's work address (joseilark@pemberline.com). Its body includes a stray line saying it was sent from your request, which you may want to delete. If you still want to send June a note, copy the bullets into your own mail.
